##  {.section-heading}

About This Course

This research practicum is offered through the [Department of Psychology and Neuroscience](https://www.bc.edu/bc-web/schools/mcas/departments/psychology-neuroscience.html) at Boston College. The course is designed for students in the Human Neuroscience Laboratory (HNL) who want hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of rigorous, transparent research.

### Why Replication Matters

Psychology has undergone a major reckoning with the reliability of its findings. Large-scale replication projects have shown that many classic results are fragile or fail to replicate entirely. This course treats that challenge not as a crisis to lament, but as an opportunity to train the next generation of researchers in practices that make science self-correcting.

### What You Will Do

-   **Select** a published study and evaluate it for replication feasibility
-   **Preregister** your hypotheses, design, and analysis plan on OSF
-   **Program** the experiment and run participants in the HNL
-   **Analyze** data using reproducible, scripted workflows (R + Quarto)
-   **Write** a fully reproducible manuscript
-   **Present** your results in a conference-style poster session
